bonus_text: Invite friends through our Telegram bot: for every confirmed payment of a friend you invited you get +7 days and +%1$s.
checkout_dialog_text: This opens a NEW website purchase in your browser. Already have a subscription? Cancel and sign in first, or use its secure renewal link.
checkout_preview_note: New purchase opens the official website. Existing customers should sign in first to renew their own subscription. Trial is available only in Telegram.
connect_engineer_profile: Using an engineer test profile from Diagnostics
connect_need_login: Sign in to get your connection settings
connect_no_plan: No active subscription to connect with
desktop_blocked: Protection is on: the internet is blocked until the VPN connects. Nothing goes around it.
desktop_emergency_confirm: Turn off and go without VPN
desktop_emergency_failed: It did not work. In a terminal run: sudo /usr/lib/marzvpn/marzvpn-helper --recover
desktop_emergency_failed_windows: It did not work, or the administrator prompt was refused. In a Command Prompt run as administrator: "C:\Program Files\MARZ VPN\marzvpn-helper.exe" --recover
desktop_emergency_text: Only if the big button did not bring your internet back. The VPN and its protection will be turned off, and your traffic will go directly, without the VPN. May ask for an administrator password.
desktop_emergency_title: Emergency: turn off VPN and restore the internet
desktop_engine_error: The VPN engine could not start (%1$s).
desktop_helper_mismatch: Parts of MARZ VPN are from different versions. Run the installer again: your sign-in and settings stay.
desktop_helper_missing: The MARZ VPN system service is not running. Reinstall the app or start the MARZ VPN helper service.
desktop_ks_locked: Can be changed while the VPN is off.
desktop_ks_off_warning: Kill Switch is off. If the VPN drops, your traffic can go directly, without the VPN.
desktop_ks_on_text: If the VPN drops, the internet is blocked until it reconnects. Nothing goes around the VPN, DNS included.
desktop_no_address: The server address could not be found. Nothing was opened: check the network or turn the VPN off and on again.
desktop_other_user: Another user of this computer turned the VPN on. Only that user or an administrator can change it.
desktop_protection_failed: The VPN did not start, because the protection could not be turned on. Your internet is unchanged and is NOT protected.
desktop_protection_lost: The protection was removed from outside the app and could not be restored. Your traffic may not be protected.
desktop_storage_unavailable: The system keyring is not available, so the app cannot keep you signed in safely. Unlock the keyring or sign in to the desktop session again.
desktop_vpn_stays_on: Closing this window keeps the app in the tray, and the VPN stays on, also after Quit from the tray menu, until you turn it off with the button.
diag_api_hint: Debug builds only. Restart the app after saving.
diag_engineer_confirm: These tools are for engineers and testing. Changing settings there can break the connection. Continue?
diag_engineer_text: Advanced tools of the VPN engine: test profiles, logs and network checks. Not needed for normal use.
diag_samples_text: Shows how the home screen looks for each plan. Marked as a sample; nothing is connected or purchased.
email_link_checked: Account status checked. The email status shown here is current.
email_link_conflict: The link cannot be changed safely. Contact support; no accounts will be merged.
email_link_hint: Confirm this email to sign in to the same VPN account. Your subscription stays unchanged.
email_link_remove_hint: Email sessions for this account will be signed out. Telegram sessions and your VPN subscription stay unchanged.
email_link_telegram: Sign in through Telegram again to manage this link.
email_link_unavailable: Email linking is not available for this account yet.
error_email_code_expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one below.
error_email_disabled: Sign-in by email is temporarily unavailable. If you bought VPN on the website, keep your purchase email and try again later.
error_email_retry_code: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Your code is kept: tap “Sign in” again in a minute.
error_expired: The time ran out. Start again.
error_invalid_code: Wrong code. Check the email and try again.
error_match_failed: A different number was chosen in the bot. Start again.
error_network: No connection to MARZ VPN. Check the internet and try again.
error_pilot_closed: The MARZ VPN app is in a closed test and sign-in is not open for your account yet. Your VPN keeps working through the Telegram bot.
error_storage: Unable to save sign-in securely. Check free storage and try again.
error_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
login_chooser_telegram_hint: If you bought in our Telegram bot.
login_chooser_text: Use the same account you already have with MARZ VPN. One subscription, whichever way you sign in.
login_email_code_sent: If sign-in by email is available for %1$s, a message with a 6-digit code arrives within a few minutes. Check the spam folder too.
login_email_hint: The code is valid for 10 minutes. We never ask for a password.
login_email_intro: Use an email linked to your Telegram account, or the email of an eligible website purchase, if email sign-in is enabled for your account.
login_email_no_trial: Email sign-in opens the plans you paid for on marzvpn.com. The free trial is available only in the Telegram bot.
login_email_resend_wait: A new code can be requested in %1$d s
login_telegram_code_hint: In the bot, tap this number. If someone sent you a sign-in link, do not confirm it.
login_telegram_intro: Sign in with the Telegram account you use in our bot. Your subscription is found automatically.
login_telegram_remember: Remember this number. In Telegram, tap exactly this number in the bot.
login_telegram_step1: Get a sign-in code: a two-digit number appears here
login_telegram_step2: Tap “Open Telegram” and choose the same number in the MARZ VPN bot
login_telegram_step3: Come back: sign-in finishes by itself
login_unavailable_preview: Sign-in is not available in this technical preview yet. It comes in the next version.
needs_account_preview: Available after sign-in (not in this preview).
no_traffic_hint: The VPN is on, but data is not getting through. Choose another route or reconnect.
open_source_note: MARZ VPN uses open-source software under GPL-3.0. The source code will be published.
pay_choose_profile: Your account has several VPN profiles. Choose the one to pay for:
pay_confirmed: Payment confirmed. Your subscription is updated.
pay_earlier_kept: If you have already paid an earlier invoice, it will be credited: there is no need to pay again.
pay_err_choose: Your account has several VPN profiles. Choose which one you are paying for.
pay_err_clock: Check the date and time on this computer (set them automatically) and try again.
pay_err_expired: The payment link has expired (it works for 2 minutes). Tap the button again.
pay_err_generic: The payment could not be opened securely. Please try again.
pay_err_network: No connection to MARZ VPN. The payment was not opened: check the internet and try again.
pay_err_no_profile: Your VPN profile was not found. A renewal is never turned into a new purchase: refresh the data or contact support.
pay_err_no_profile_first: Your account has no VPN profile yet. A first purchase is made as a new customer: on marzvpn.com (then sign in to the app with the same email) or in the Telegram bot.
pay_err_off: Secure checkout for this profile is temporarily unavailable. Use the renewal channel below.
pay_err_off_bot: Renew in our Telegram bot: it recognises you by your Telegram account.
pay_err_off_site: Renew with the secure link from your marzvpn.com purchase email.
pay_err_off_unknown: Renew where you bought the subscription: in the Telegram bot or with the link from your purchase email.
pay_err_profile_gone: The list of your VPN profiles has changed. Check the choice and try again.
pay_err_review: This profile cannot be paid for automatically: support has to check it. Accounts are never merged without you.
pay_err_signed_out: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then repeat the payment.
pay_err_unavailable: Payment is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
pay_hint: Payment is made for your own VPN profile: your access key, days and traffic stay. It opens where the profile was set up: on marzvpn.com or in the Telegram bot. The link works once, for 2 minutes.
pay_no_order: No order has been created yet, nothing is paid. You can return to payment or choose another plan.
pay_opened_bot: The payment is open in the Telegram bot. Use the same Telegram account you signed in to the app with. After paying, come back to the app: the subscription updates by itself.
pay_opened_site: The payment page is open on marzvpn.com. After paying, come back to the app: the subscription updates by itself.
pay_receipt_failed: This payment was not completed. Check its status before starting another checkout.
pay_receipt_fulfilling: Payment confirmed by the server. Applying the subscription; do not pay again.
pay_waiting: Waiting for this order. Returning from checkout does not confirm payment.
payment_methods_note: Available payment methods are shown on the checkout page and depend on the plan.
plan_ip3: Up to 3 public IPs at the same time
plans_subtitle: Every plan works on all MARZ VPN servers.
reauth_text: Please sign in again to confirm your session. Your VPN keeps working meanwhile.
referral_bot_hint: In the bot, tap “🎁 Invite Friends”. Referrals will move into the app later.
route_check_needs_vpn: Route availability is checked while the VPN is connected.
route_failed: Does not connect from this network
route_missing_text: It is no longer in your subscription. Choose another route; the VPN was not switched.
sample_banner: Interface sample. These are not your real data.
servers_preview_note: The server list will come from your account. In this preview your choice is saved but not yet applied to the connection.
store_purchase_later: Purchase in this version is coming later
subscription_signed_out_text: Sign in to see your plan, expiry date and traffic, or choose a plan.
sync_error: Could not update the account. Showing the last saved data.
trial_preview_note: The trial is issued only in our Telegram bot @MarzReality_bot. Already have one? Sign in with Telegram and it will appear here.
trial_terms: %1$d days or %2$s, whichever comes first. For new users, under the current Trial rules.
welcome_point_no_setup: No links, keys or manual setup
welcome_point_one_account: One account for Telegram and the website
welcome_tagline: Fast, private internet with one tap
